Article 4 (Emission Control Device Standards, etc.)
① The "standards as specified in Article 10(2) of this Act" refers to the technical standards for sulfur oxide emission control devices as specified in Article 30(2) and Schedule 20, Item 3 of the "Regulations on Prevention of Pollution from Ships."
② The "sulfur oxide emission limitation standard as specified in Article 10(2) of this Act" refers to the case where the ratio of sulfur dioxide emission (ppm) to carbon dioxide emission (volume percentage) in the exhaust gas is 4.3 [4.3 SO2(ppm)/CO2(%, v/v)].
③ When a ship navigates in a restricted area, the owner of the ship shall record the following items in the ship's log, as required by Article 10(3) of this Act:
1. Ship equipped with an emission control device as specified in Article 10(2) of this Act: Operating conditions of the emission control device
2. Ship that has exchanged fuel oil in a restricted area
